tagline: Firewall for AI agents on PayPal

apiDocs.title: API
apiDocs.intro: Your shop's own app calls three endpoints with an API key: create one below. In the reference, use Authorize to paste a key and try them here: with a key, a request runs on live PayPal while live mode is on; without one, your session is used and it always runs on the sandbox.
